text: すてきな　かぜに　さそわれて　こんな　ところまで　きてしまったわ

structure.jp: すてきな　かぜに　さそわれて
こんな　ところまで　きてしまったわ
structure.en: I ended up coming all the way out here

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: かぜに　さそわれて
patterns.explanation: This verb ending says the thing is done to the speaker, and に shows who or what does it. かぜに　さそわれて = 'being lured by the breeze'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happened completely, often without really meaning to. きてしまった = 'I ended up coming'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins this part to the next and here gives the reason for it. さそわれて = 'lured, and so'.
